environment.description: Same application container deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode only, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in BLOCK mode, (3) a custom rule group 'corp-query-inspection' containing a RegexPatternSet match on query string values with pattern '(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|\bor\b\s+\d+\s*=\s*\d+|--\s*$|/\*.*\*/)' set to BLOCK, and (4) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in BLOCK mode including SQLi_QUERYARGUMENTS which uses AWS's proprietary SQL injection detection engine on all query string parameters. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm the SQLi rule group evaluates every request reaching the ALB.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 WebACL association

waf_web_acl_rules.name: AWS-AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet
waf_web_acl_rules.note: All rules active including SQLi_QUERYARGUMENTS and SQLi_BODY

config.compute: ECS Fargate, private subnet, ALB in public subnet
config.network: application in private subnet, no direct internet access
